facts.fact: Adwave's worked example describes a local med spa running a $1,200/month CTV flight across eight zip codes.
facts.quote: A local med spa runs a $1,200/month CTV flight across eight zip codes.

facts.fact: In the same worked example, the med spa budgets $150/month for branded search ads before launch.
In the worked example, the med spa budgets $400/month for a retargeting plus synchronized-social layer using stills from the TV spot.
facts.quote: a $400/month retargeting plus synchronized-social layer using stills from the TV spot.

facts.fact: Adwave states that for small budgets, even $300-500 of synchronized social per month measurably amplifies a TV flight.
facts.quote: For small budgets, even $300-500 of synchronized social per month measurably amplifies a TV flight

facts.fact: Adwave says the time lag between TV impressions and conversions is expected to be 1-3 weeks for most local categories.
facts.quote: expecting a 1-3 week lag for most local categories

facts.fact: In the illustrative worked example, branded searches in the targeted zips rose 31% in week 2 of the flight.
facts.quote: Week 2: branded searches up 31% in the targeted zips.

facts.fact: In the illustrative worked example, bookings climbed 22% over baseline during weeks 4-8.
In the illustrative worked example, the QR code generated 85 total scans, of which 19 booked directly.
facts.quote: QR scans total 85, of which 19 booked directly.

facts.fact: The page advises keeping the digital layers (retargeting and follow-up channels) live for at least 30-45 days after the TV flight ends.
facts.quote: Keep the digital layers live for at least 30-45 days after the TV flight ends.

facts.fact: The page suggests a starting budget ratio of about 70% to the CTV flight and 30% across branded search, retargeting, and synchronized social.
facts.quote: A useful starting ratio is 70/30: roughly 70% to the CTV flight that creates the demand and 30% across branded search, retargeting, and synchronized social to capture it.

facts.fact: The page says that when total budget is below $1,000, the advertiser should simplify to TV plus branded search plus the site pixel.
facts.quote: Below $1,000 total, simplify to TV plus branded search plus the pixel, which costs almost nothing and preserves the core loop.

facts.fact: The page states that Adwave lets users generate a TV spot in about two minutes (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: generate your spot in about two minutes, add your QR code, target your zips, and launch the flight your funnel is ready to catch.

facts.fact: The page recommends a holdout test of running the full system in one market and digital-only in a comparable market for one quarter to measure the TV effect.
facts.quote: run the full system in one market and digital-only in a comparable one for a quarter

facts.fact: The page states that many advertisers see their best blended efficiency in the two weeks immediately after a TV flight ends (unsourced claim in the article).
facts.quote: Many advertisers see their best blended efficiency in the two weeks immediately after a flight, when the retargeting pool is at its largest and the TV spend has stopped.
